Cherry Cherry Chocolate Cupcakes
By: Ben Nash
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:20pm

Ingredients




1 package of Deep Chocolate VitaMix
2 egg whites
1 cup water
cup ¼  of Cherry flavored Craisins or dried cherries
1 teaspoon of cherry flavored extract
Cool Whip Free

12 Maraschino cherries to Decorate

Preparation

1 Prepare Vitalicious Deep Chocolate VitaMix according to package instructions. 2 Add Cherry flavored extract and dried cherry pieces. 3 Mix well. 4 Bake in festive aluminum baking cups for about 25 minutes. 5 Allow thorough cooling. 6 Dip muffin top side down into "frosting" and top each frosted cupcake with Maraschino cherry.

About


Tip: Do not frost cupcakes until ready to serve. That way you can still freeze any unused, unfrosted cupcakes for later.
